data.name: Enhanced CP/M networking upgrade for Aurelia
data.vendor: Logix / AION Software / Digital Research cooperation

introduced.event_name: NCC 1981 — Logix networking / Artemis PRO launch

data.delivery: system/software upgrade supplied with the Aurelia network-adapter offer
data.api_compatibility: Retains the base platform C/TUI API; optional networking services are discovered through versioned capability checks.

network_link_policy.driver_contract: Enforce host rate ceilings, report advertised and negotiated rates separately, process packet-level interrupts and receiver credits, and expose fallback/error diagnostics. TCP/IP application throughput is below shared raw line rate and requires measurement.
